cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
裁决官督法者
2 6" 4+ 9
天鹰使节：
• 每当一名敌方特工位于己方天鹰使节标识（如果
该标识不位于杀戮区，则每当敌方特工位于该单
位）的 3" 内时，那名敌方特工在执行拾取标识或
任务行动时必须多消耗 1AP。
• 在判断对标识的控制权时，如果有至少一名争夺
标识的敌方特工位于己方天鹰使节标识（如果标
识不位于杀戮区，则是敌方特工位于该特工）的
3" 内，那么将争夺标识的敌方特工的 APL 属性
总和视作为比原本要低 1 点。请注意，这并非对
APL 属性的修正，因此任何修正效果将与本规则
的效果叠加。
部署天鹰使节 0AP
如果天鹰使节标识不位于杀戮区内，那么将其部
署在该特工水平 6" 内的位置；若是其他情况，
将己方天鹰使节标识水平移动最多 6"。如果该
特工被移出杀戮区，那么将己方天鹰使节标识移
出杀戮区。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行本
行动。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
ARBITES PROCTOR-EXACTANT
2 6" 4+ 9
Nuncio-aquila:
• Whenever an enemy operative is within 3" of your
Nuncio-aquila marker (or this operative if your Nuncio-aquila
marker isn’t in the killzone), your opponent must spend 1
additional AP for that enemy operative to perform the Pick
Up Marker and mission actions.
• Whenever determining control of a marker, treat the total
APL stat of enemy operatives that contest it as 1 lower if
at least one of those enemy operatives is within 3" of your
Nuncio-aquila marker (or this operative if your Nuncio-aquila
marker isn’t in the killzone). Note this isn’t a change to the APL
stat, so any changes are cumulative with this.
DEPLOY NUNCIO-AQUILA 0AP
If your Nuncio-aquila marker isn’t in the killzone, place it
within 6" horizontally of this operative; otherwise, move your
Nuncio-aquila marker up to 6" horizontally. If this operative
is removed from the killzone, remove your Nuncio-aquila
marker from the killzone.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

Medic!: The first time during each turning point that another friendly EXACTION SQUAD operative would be incapacitated while
visible to and within 3" of this operative, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that operative is within control range of an
enemy operative. If you do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining and cannot be incapacitated for the
remainder of the action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately perform a free Dash action, but must end that
move within this operative’s control range. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats until the end of their next activations
respectively, and if this rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that activation ends. You cannot use this rule if this
operative is incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would be a primary or secondary target.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
EXACTION SQUAD , IMPERIUM, ADEPTUS ARBITES, MEDIC, CHIRURGANT 28

强征小队
杀戮小队

特工
↘ 1 名强征小队督法者特工，装备有以下一种
选项：
• 战斗霰弹枪；镇压短棍
• 霰弹手枪；统御棰与突击盾
↘ 10 名强征小队特工，从以下列表中选择：
• 惩罚者 • 神枪手
• 外科医生 • 启示者
• 束犬大师 • 冲覆者
• R-VR 赛博猎犬 • 警戒者
• 定迹者 • 辨音者
• 炮手，装备有以下一种选项：
○ 榴弹发射器；镇压短棍

○ 捕网枪；镇压短棍

cards.text:
除了炮手、冲覆者和警戒者特工以外，上述的每
一名特工只能被纳入您的杀戮小队一次。您的杀
戮小队可以包含最多两名炮手特工（每一名特工
的装备选项必须不同），以及最多四名冲覆者
特工。
cards.text_en:
Other than GUNNER, SUBDUCTOR and VIGILANT
operatives, your kill team can only include each
operative on this list once. Your kill team can
only include up to two GUNNER operatives (each
must have a different option) and up to four
SUBDUCTOR operatives.

cards.text:
强征小队
阵营规则
无情效率
无论是被标记逮捕还是消灭，被法务部盯上
的目标无处可藏。
每当一名己方强征小队特工进行射击时（破片
和穿甲手雷除外)，您可以在选择有效目标时使
用本规则。若使用，敌方特工的控制范围内存在
其他己方强征小队特工并不会阻止该敌方特工
被选择成为目标。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FACTION RULE
RUTHLESS EFFICIENCY
A target, whether marked to be apprehended or
eliminated, stands little chance of escaping the
attention of an Adeptus Arbites Exaction Squad.
Whenever a friendly EXACTION SQUAD
operative is shooting (excluding with frag or krak
grenades) and you’re selecting a valid target, you
can use this rule. If you do, having other friendly
EXACTION SQUAD operatives within an enemy
operative’s control range doesn’t prevent that
enemy operative from being selected.

cards.text:
强征小队
阵营规则
标记审判
强征小队会将注意力集中在被标记的目标身
上，在那之后将仇恨转向下一个罪人。
战略计划。选择一个敌方特工在转折点中进行标
记。每当一名己方强征小队特工对标记的特工
进行射击、近战或反击时，那名己方特工的武
器拥有“重击”武器规则。在标记的特工被残废
后，您可以在转折点中选择新的敌方特工进行标
记(并且在转折点期间可以持续这个过程)。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FACTION RULE
MARKED FOR JUSTICE
Exaction Squads prioritise their targets, focusing their
ire on those marked for immediate punishment before
moving on to the next transgressor.
STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select one enemy operative
to be your mark for the turning point. Whenever a
friendly EXACTION SQUAD operative is shooting
against, fighting against or retaliating against
your mark, that friendly operative's weapons
have the Punishing weapon rule. Whenever your
mark is incapacitated, you can select a new
enemy operative to be your mark for the turning
point (and can continue to do so during this
turning point).

cards.text:
强征小队
阵营规则
镇压
执法部拥有镇压暴动、叛逆以及各种骚动的
经验，无论敌人身份如何，他们都能够保持
自身的坚毅。
本杀戮小队规则中的一些武器拥有“镇压”武器
规则，具体如下。
*镇压：每当该特工使用本武器时：
• 您的每一次格挡可以被用来格挡两次未结算的
成功（而不是一次)。
• 如果该特工正在进行反击，那么您先结算第一
枚攻击骰（也就是防守方先结算，而不是进
攻方)。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FACTION RULE
REPRESS
Experienced in suppressing riots, rebellions and various
other kinds of unrest, the Adeptus Arbites are resilient
in the face of any oncoming foe, no matter their origin.
Some weapons in this team’s rules have the
Repress weapon rule below.
*Repress: Whenever this operative is using
this weapon:
• Each of your blocks can be allocated to block
two unresolved successes (instead of one).
• If this operative is retaliating, you resolve
the first attack dice (i.e. defender instead
of attacker).

cards.text:
强征小队
标识/指示物指南
医疗扣押标记审判
指示物指示物指示物
核实扫描侦测激进
指示物指示物指示物
迅捷防御天鹰使节
指示物指示物标识

EXACTION SQUAD
MARKER/TOKEN GUIDE
Medic token Apprehend Marked for
token Justice token
Veriscant token Spot token Aggressive
token
Swift token Defensive Nuncio-aquila
token marker

cards.text:
强征小队
战略计谋
罪恶自我揭示
强征小队在追击罪人时绝不会留情。几乎没
有人能够逃过他们的追捕。
在您为己方强征小队特工选择有效目标时，位
于那名特工 4" 内的敌方特工无法拥有掩护（而
不是 2")。虽然这能够让上述的特工成为有效目
标（假设他们可见)，但并不会移除特工拥有的
任何掩护豁免，除非己方强征小队特工和常规
一样位于那名特工的 2" 内。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
GUILT REVEALS ITSELF
Exaction Squads are relentless in their pursuit of the
condemned. Few escape their clutches.
Whenever you’re selecting a valid target for a
friendly EXACTION SQUAD operative, enemy
operatives within 4" of it cannot be in cover
(instead of 2"). While this can allow such
operatives to be targeted (assuming they’re
visible), it doesn’t remove their cover save (if
any), unless the friendly EXACTION SQUAD
operative is within 2" as normal.

cards.text:
强征小队
战略计谋
不可侵犯的权威
强征小队被他们所拥有的权威激励，他们为
了守住关键位置会狂热地进行战斗。
在一名特工对位于目标标识或敌方特工 2" 内的
己方强征小队特工进行射击时，您可以重掷一
枚自己的防御骰。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
INVIOLATE JURISDICTION
Emboldened by the authority they hold, Exaction
Squads will fight with zealous determination to hold key
positions against the foe.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
EXACTION SQUAD operative that’s within 2" of
an objective marker or an enemy operative, you
can re-roll one of your defence dice.

cards.text:
强征小队
战略计谋
施予正义
在追击罪人时，裁决官们极度专注，他们纪
律严明且决心坚定。
在一名己方强征小队特工进行近战或反击时，
如果特工在激活期间没有移动超过其移动属性，
或者如果特工正在进行反应，那么其近战武器拥
有“无休”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
DISPENSE JUSTICE
In pursuit of the guilty, Arbitrators are focused,
disciplined and utterly determined.
Whenever a friendly EXACTION SQUAD
operative is fighting or retaliating, if it hasn’t
moved more than its Move stat during the
activation, or if it's a counteraction, its melee
weapons have the Ceaseless weapon rule.

cards.text:
强征小队
战略计谋
最终判决
一个危险的敌人被宣判犯下了重罪，并且必
须立即将其消灭。
每当一名己方强征小队特工对一名位于其 6" 内
的敌方特工进行射击时，或每当一名己方强征小
队炮手特工进行射击时，那名己方特工的远程
武器拥有“平衡”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
TERMINAL DECREE
A dangerous quarry has been judged guilty of heinous
crimes against the Imperium and must be terminated
with extreme prejudice.
Whenever a friendly EXACTION SQUAD
operative is shooting an enemy operative within
6" of it, or whenever a friendly EXACTION
SQUAD GUNNER operative is shooting, that
friendly operative’s ranged weapons have the
Balanced weapon rule.

cards.title_en: LONG ARM OF THE EMPEROR'S LAW
cards.text:
强征小队
交战计谋
帝皇律法的长臂
没有人能够逃过法务部的无情审判。
在一名己方强征小队特工执行射击行动时，如
果您选择了一件拥有“范围 X”武器规则的武器
（破片和穿甲手雷除外)，那么您可以使用本规
则。直到那次行动结束前，X 的距离增加 3"。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
LONG ARM OF THE EMPEROR'S LAW
No one escapes the merciless judgement of the
Adeptus Arbites.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly EXACTION
SQUAD operative is performing the Shoot
action and you select a weapon with the Range
x weapon rule (excluding frag or krak grenade).
Until the end of that action, add 3" to x.

cards.text:
强征小队
交战计谋
实行制裁
对一名裁决官出手是一项可以被立即处决的
罪行。
在一名敌方特工对其 6" 内的一名己方强征小队
特工进行射击或近战后，如果那名己方特工没
有被残废，那么您可以使用本交战计谋。那名己
方特工可以立即执行一次无消耗的近战或射击行
动，但是其他敌方特工不能被选择成为那次行
动的有效目标或近战对象（但依旧可以成为“爆
炸”武器规则的次要目标)。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
EXACT PUNISHMENT
To strike against an Arbitrator is an offence punishable
by immediate termination.
Use this firefight ploy after an enemy operative
shoots against or fights against a friendly
EXACTION SQUAD operative within 6" of it, and
that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated as a
result. That friendly operative can immediately
perform either a free Shoot or a free Fight action,
but you cannot select any other enemy operative
as a valid target or to fight against during that
action (note that secondary targets from the Blast
weapon rule can still be targeted).

cards.text:
强征小队
交战计谋
残暴支援
在面对最为难缠的敌人时，裁决官们会将力
量聚集在一起，使用棍棒和手棰痛击罪人。
在一名己方强征小队特工的激活期间，在它执
行行动的之前或之后使用本交战计谋。选择一名
位于其控制范围内的敌方特工，另一名己方强
征小队特工可以立即执行一次无消耗的近战行
动，但只能以那名敌方特工作为近战对象。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
BRUTAL BACKUP
When combating the most belligerent of foes,
Arbitrators may combine their considerable might to
bludgeon the guilty with baton and maul.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly EXACTION
SQUAD operative’s activation, before or after it
performs an action. Select one enemy operative
within its control range. One other friendly
EXACTION SQUAD operative can immediately
perform a free Fight action, but you cannot select
any other enemy operative to fight against during
that action.

cards.text:
强征小队
交战计谋
处刑命令
那些触怒人类帝国的存在将被法务部标记进
行处决，他们将被优先针对。
在一名敌方特工执行任务行动（操作舱门除外）
时使用本交战计谋。或者在交战行动结束时使
用本交战计谋。选择一名控制目标标识的敌方
特工。
在上述任意情况中，当您的对手下一次将要激活
被选择的敌方特工时，您可以打断那次激活并激
活一名就绪的己方强征小队特工。若这么做，
那么那名己方特工必须对被选择的敌方特工进行
近战或者射击，并且直到完成之前不能对其他
敌方特工进行近战或射击（如果无法达成这个条
件，那么那名己方特工的激活被取消)。
在完成那名己方特工的激活后，继续那名敌方特
工的激活（若可能)。直到被选择的敌方特工被
激活或残废前，您无法再次使用本交战计谋。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
EXECUTION ORDER
Those who have earned the ire of the Imperium are
marked by the Adeptus Arbites for execution, their
termination prioritised.
Use this firefight ploy when an enemy operative
performs a mission action (excluding Operate
Hatch). Alternatively, use it at the end of the
Firefight phase and select one enemy operative
that controls an objective marker.
In either case, the next time your opponent would
activate that enemy operative, you can interrupt
that activation and activate a ready friendly
EXACTION SQUAD operative. If you do, during
that activation, that friendly operative must shoot
against or fight against that enemy operative, and
cannot do so against any other enemy operatives
until it does (if this isn’t possible, that friendly
operative’s activation is cancelled).
After completing that friendly operative’s
activation, continue that enemy operative’s
activation (if possible). You cannot use this ploy
again until that enemy operative is activated
or incapacitated.

cards.text:
强征小队
阵营装备
加固目镜
这个装甲目镜能够帮助佩戴者抵御武器和其
他装置所产生的致盲和眩晕效果。
您可以忽略任何对己方强征小队特工 APL 属性
的修正，并且不会受到敌方特工“震荡”武器规
则的影响。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
REINFORCED MIRROR-VISOR
This armoured visor is designed to shield the wearer
from blinding and disorientating weapons or devices.
You can ignore any changes to the APL stat of
friendly EXACTION SQUAD operatives, and
they aren’t affected by enemy operatives’ Shock
weapon rule.

cards.text:
强征小队
阵营装备
镣铐
这对精金镣铐能够阻止受捕目标逃脱逮捕。
每当一名位于己方强征小队特工控制范围内的
敌方特工执行后撤行动时，如果那名己方特工的
控制范围内不存在任何其他敌方特工，那么您可
以使用本规则。若使用，掷 2D6，如果敌方特工
的耐伤属性大于那名己方特工，则掷一枚 D6。
如果有任何掷骰结果为 4+，那名敌方特工不能
在那次激活或反应期间执行那个行动（不会消耗
任何 AP)，并且您不能在这个转折点中再次使用
这个规则。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
MANACLES
These adamantine manacles prevent captive subjects
from escaping custody.
Whenever an enemy operative would perform
the Fall Back action while within control range
of a friendly EXACTION SQUAD operative, if no
other enemy operatives are within that friendly
operative’s control range, you can use this rule.
If you do, roll two D6, or one D6 if that enemy
operative has a higher Wounds stat than that
friendly operative. If any result is a 4+, that enemy
operative cannot perform that action during that
activation/counteraction (no AP are spent on it),
and you cannot use this rule again during this
turning point.

cards.text:
强征小队
阵营装备
频闪磷光灯
这个明亮的白色闪光灯会使照射到的敌人陷入眩晕。
当一名敌方特工对位于其 2" 内的己方强征小队
特工进行射击、近战和反击时，您的对手不能重
掷结果为 1 的攻击骰。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
STROBING PHOSPHOR-LUMEN
The brilliant white, flickering light of this rotating lumen
device has the effect of disorientating foes caught in
its beam.
Whenever an enemy operative is shooting
against, fighting against or retaliating against a
friendly EXACTION SQUAD operative within 2" of
it, your opponent cannot re-roll their attack dice
results of 1.

cards.text:
强征小队
阵营装备
特殊弹药
裁决官的霰弹枪可以使用各种类型的特殊弹
药，这包括燃烧弹和穿甲独头弹。
每个转折点限两次，当一名己方强征小队特工
执行射击行动时，而您选择了战斗霰弹枪、处刑
者霰弹枪、带瞄准镜的霰弹手枪或霰弹手枪，便
可以使用本规则。若使用，选择以下一个武器规
则，它将在行动结束前生效：
• 集中。
• 穿刺 1，但是只有在目标的豁免属性为 3+ 或
更佳时才生效。
• 洪流 1"，但是您不能选择超过一个次要目标。
cards.text_en:
EXACTION SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SPECIAL ISSUE SHELLS
Arbites shotguns can be loaded with a wide range of
specialist ammunition, including but not limited to
incendiary rounds and armour-piercing slugs.
Up to twice per turning point, when a friendly
EXACTION SQUAD operative is performing the
Shoot action and you select a combat shotgun,
executioner shotgun, scoped shotpistol or
shotpistol, you can use this rule. If you do, select
one of the following weapon rules for that weapon
to have until the end of that action:
• Saturate.
• Piercing 1, but only if the target has a Save stat
of 3+ or better.
• Torrent 1", but you cannot select more than
one secondary target.
